title: dvh crossings
description: Crossings between domains. No verdict here is a sign-off.

width.description: Width of the receiving register, in bits.

direct.description: True if the sender reaches D with no logic between and the receiving register takes it on every clock; an enable makes this false, because the value is held rather than resampled.

second_stage.description: Same-domain registers fed directly by this one.

src.$comment: Constrained so a blank or a non-location cannot pass.

shape_recognized.description: True if this matches a known shape.
shape_recognized.$comment: Two-flop, and not one of several carrying one value.

note.description: Empty when known; else what was seen.

same_clock_source.description: True if both clocks resolve to one identical clock net, as a gated clock does. This is the only flag that keeps a reported crossing out of `unrecognized`, so it is the only route by which a crossing does not fail the run.
same_clock_source.$comment: The test is the net, not the source name: every bit of a vector clock port, and of a black box's clock output bus, carries one name.

crossings.description: Every crossing found, safe or not.

unrecognized.description: The crossings this run fails on: every crossing except those whose two clocks are one net. A crossing here is not necessarily a defect, and one absent from here is not necessarily correct -- see `shape_recognized`.
unrecognized.$comment: A shape to look at, not a bug.

$comment: Reports a recognized shape, never whether a crossing is safe.
